definitions.gloss: clocking in/out; stamping the time on a record
definitions.explanation: The act of recording one's start or end of work time, traditionally by stamping a time card and now often by scanning a card or using a smartphone app.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出社|しゅっしゃ}→出社：06155_shussha⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{打刻|だこく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please clock in when you arrive at the office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{退勤|たいきん}→退勤：04550_taikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打刻|だこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Yesterday I forgot to clock out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ICカード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{出退勤|しゅったいきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打刻|だこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っています→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At our company, we use IC cards to record clock-in and clock-out times.

notes:
Literally 'stamp engraving'. Originally referred to the act of physically stamping a time card; now used broadly for any electronic time-recording action. Common in workplace HR documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {打刻|だこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clock in/out
- ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打刻|だこく}: clock-in (recording)
- ⟦{退勤|たいきん}→退勤：04550_taikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打刻|だこく}: clock-out (recording)
- {打刻|だこく}⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧: missed clock-in/out
- {打刻|だこく}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: time recorded
